title: Canonical etale module evaluation and tensor-power constructions
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of algebraic spaces over $S$ with their small etale module categories [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Use the specified module direct image, tensor pullback and adjunction [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. For a module $M$ on $X$, define its evaluation $f^*f_*M\to M$ to be the counit of this adjunction. Here a cofan is a cocone on a discrete diagram, with colimiting meaning the colimit universal property [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Given cofans $c$ of $(f_*B_d)_{d\geq0}$ and $b$ of $(B_d)_{d\geq0}$, their pulled cofan has vertex $f^*(c.pt)$ and injections $f^*(c.inj_d)$. When this pulled cofan is colimiting, define total evaluation $f^*(c.pt)\to b.pt$ by its composites with these injections: the degree-$d$ counit followed by $b.inj_d$. On the small affine etale ringed model with restriction equivalence [def-sfb-space-small-ringed-model], use the existing sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For any module $L$ on $X$, define $P_0=\mathcal O$ and $P_{n+1}=L|_{small}\otimes P_n$ on this model, and define $L^{\otimes n}$ on the original site by the inverse restriction equivalence applied to $P_n$. Use the unitors and associator of a monoidal category [def-sfb-monoidal-category], namely those of the sheaf tensor of module sheaves on the small model with unit $\mathcal O$: on local pure tensors [def-pur-module-pure-tensor] the left unitor sends $r\otimes s$ to $rs$ and the associator sends $(s\otimes t)\otimes u$ to $s\otimes(t\otimes u)$, which determines them by the bilinear universal property of the sheaf tensor [lem-pc-sites-sheaf-tensor-bilinear-universal]. Concatenation $P_{m+n}\simeq P_m\otimes P_n$ is recursively given by the inverse left unitor for $m=0$, and by tensoring the preceding comparison with $L|_{small}$ then the inverse associator for the successor step. For module sheaves $M,N$ on the small model, an object $V$ of it and sections $s\in M(V)$, $t\in N(V)$, the local pure-tensor section $s\otimes t\in(M\otimes N)(V)$ is the existing canonical pure-tensor section [def-pur-module-pure-tensor]: the sectionwise tensor $s\otimes_{\mathcal O(V)}t$ mapped through the presheaf-to-sheafification unit [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] and the inverse of the tensor/sheafification identification. These constructions include all degrees, arbitrary modules, all module-sheaf cofans, and the original coefficient universe.
